method.counts_scope: Snapshot counts cover all retained CORE+ADJACENT; default view is CORE+seeds. Map counters describe current filters.
method.full_text_scope: Full-text evidence counts use recorded evidence_level only; open-access links do not imply text was read or stored.

privacy_withholding.rule: Whole public abstract or evidence text fields containing an IPv4 address are withheld; private source text is unchanged. This is separate from permission withholding.
